currentContext.expansion: The only expansion disclosed in the routed text is an energy asset rather than added manufacturing capacity: the Company has installed a solar power plant at its Savli Plant 'to promote the use of renewable energy and reduce dependence on conventional sources of power', at a capital investment of Rs. 123.33 Lakhs. The Directors' Report is internally inconsistent on its output - one line states that 'During the financial year under review, the solar power plant generated approximately 11,14,367 units of electricity, resulting in reduced grid power consumption', while the following line states the plant 'generated solar Electricity of 1,80,000 units during the Financial Year 2024-25'. No installed solar MW rating is given. Beyond this, there was no change in the nature of the business, no subsidiary, associate or joint venture was formed, no loans, guarantees or investments in other body corporates were made, no scrapped plant and machinery was sold in FY 2025-26, and the Company states 'There were no material changes that have affected the financial position of the Company which have occurred between the end of financial year on 31st March, 2026 and till the date of this report.' The MD&A notes that gross fixed assets including leasehold land, plant and machinery decreased year on year, and the Company confirms it has taken no new technology for absorption and carries out no research and development activities. No new plant, line, debottlenecking or commissioning timeline is disclosed anywhere in this bundle.
